business_problem: LG U+ needed to reduce its dependency on external LLM providers because latency, outages, and operating costs were directly affecting AI search and voice experiences for telecom customers.
solution_summary: LG U+ uses Databricks Model Serving, AI Gateway, Genie, and Gemini 2.5 Flash to support AI search and voice services with resilient model serving. LG U+ needed to reduce its dependency on external LLM providers because latency, outages, and operating costs were directly affecting AI search and voice experiences for telecom customers. In practice, the implementation governs access and lineage with AI Gateway, runs transformation or AI logic on Gemini 2.5 Flash, and delivers outputs through Databricks Model Serving. Tickets, conversation history, knowledge articles, and operational context are consolidated into a governed cloud data layer; Gemini 2.5 Flash applies analytics or model logic; results are surfaced through Databricks Model Serving.
